correctness.rationale: The erasing map sends fair-bit input to a two-state Markov output with P(initial 0)=2/3 and flip probability 2/3, giving ν([w])=2^(1_{w1=0}+flips(w))/3^n. Published F²_*λ=λ and ergodicity of F² for λ then yield F_*ν=λ and μ=(λ+ν)/2 invariant and F-ergodic; Birkhoff on the even F² and odd F∘F² subsequences proves full-Lebesgue physicality. Bernoulli and Markov flip laws give cylinder exponents 1 and log₂3−2/3. Typical terminal-run length O(log n) via Borel–Cantelli controls adjacent dyadic cylinders and transfers to Euclidean-ball local dimensions. Mutual singularity of λ and ν gives exact μ masses 1/2 each. Independently checked all 2^n Markov-cylinder masses sum to one for n≤8 and recomputed exponent 0.918295834...; infinite almost-sure claims rest on the cited mixing premise and analytic proof.

evidence: F² mixing and preservation imply ergodicity of λ for the square; they do not themselves establish a dimension distribution for μ=(λ+F_*λ)/2.
